thread_text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 429s and 503s from public text-generation endpoint (region: eu-west-1). 10m 429 rate up 8x; 503s up 3x. Paging oncall.

Maya Patel: seeing it on the alert too. I'm oncall. grabbing dashboard.

Oliver Chen: looks correlated with one tenant (tenant=alpha-market) but a few other tenants show bump. Could be prefix cache churn after sudden spike.

Maya Patel: confirmed — top 5 tenants account for ~60% of the 429 delta. alpha-market is ~38%.

Kai Rivera: is this client-side retry overload or server throttling? 429 suggests our rate limiter. 503s could be eviction or OOMs.

Maya Patel: checking pod errors and kube events.

Deploy Bot: Deploy 1742 completed to prod-eu at 1829873820. No rollbacks.

Nina Gomez: any recent rollout to the model or runtime?

Oliver Chen: model unchanged. runtime nodes had a config push yesterday with new batching heuristics, but that was low-risk. I'll flag it.

Maya Patel: pod logs: some workers hit `KVCache miss` messages and increased tail-latency. Throughput reduced per pod -> rate limiter stepping in.

Kai Rivera: immediate mitigation idea: raise tenant-specific quota temporarily for alpha-market to avoid 429s for them, while we slow down noisy tenants with soft caps. We can also enable aggressive prefix caching.

Maya Patel: agree. Plan: 1) surgical increase alpha-market quota by 30% for 20m; 2) apply temporary global backpressure via smoothing for non-critical routes; 3) disable optional telemetry that creates extra callouts for high QPS paths. Anyone object?

Oliver Chen: +1. Need to communicate to CS for potential customer impact.

Nina Gomez: I'll ping CS and put an incident note.

Maya Patel: executing step 1. running command: ```
redwoodctl quota set --tenant alpha-market --rate 1.3x --duration 20m --reason "live mitigation - 429 spike"
```

Maya Patel: command accepted. quota delta applied to edge-proxy pools.

Kai Rivera: applying per-route smoothing policy to public-gen endpoint: ```
redwoodctl policy patch --route /v1/generate --policy smoothing --window 200ms --max-burst 50
```

Oliver Chen: toggled smoothing. watch metrics.

Maya Patel: disabling telemetry hook on high-qps path now: ```
kubectl patch configmap infra-flags -n redwood --patch '{"data":{"extra_telemetry":"false"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy -n redwood
```

Deploy Bot: restart of deploy/edge-proxy started (5 pods rolling).

Maya Patel: immediate metric check: within 90s 429s dropped ~45% and 503s down ~30%. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyz/429-503-live?orgId=1&from=now-15m

Kai Rivera: that's promising. Need to track tail latency and queueing. Are any nodes OOMing?

Maya Patel: no OOMs, no node restarts. CPU on some pods increased. KV cache hit rate recovering slowly.

Oliver Chen: curious if alpha-market change will let other tenants get throttled; but seems okay — non-critical tenants saw small increases in 429 but within SLO for now.

Nina Gomez: CS notified: "We see elevated errors but mitigation in progress. We'll update in 30m."

Maya Patel: can someone take on continuous watch? I'll prepare notes for handoff.

Kai Rivera: I'll stay for next 30. I'll also kick a temporary ps-limiting rule on top noisy clients: ```
redwoodctl rate add --selector "tenant in (beta-shop, gamma-saas)" --limit 150rps --duration 30m --reason "noise control"
```

Oliver Chen: applied. small waveform visible on dashboard.

Maya Patel: alert thresholds adjusted to avoid noisy flapping: lowered sensitivity on 503 alert to 2x for 10m window.

Incident Bot: Update: Alert suppressed for 503 flapping; custom notes added.

Maya Patel: good. We're seeing 429 rate back to near-baseline except small tail. We'll keep alpha-market at +30% for 20m then roll back and observe. If 429 increases again, we'll open targeted support with their infra team.

Nina Gomez: CS asked about whether we need to proactively throttle a problematic customer — they'd prefer we try quota bump first. They're on standby.

Kai Rivera: any opt-in features we can disable to reduce load? We already toggled extra telemetry. There is an experimental reranking service we can disable per-route.

Maya Patel: yes, I'm going to route alpha-market to a cheaper model variant for one hour to reduce backend compute. Command: ```
redwoodctl route update --tenant alpha-market --model redwood-lite-v1 --duration 1h --reason "mitigation"
```

Maya Patel: switched. model variant change propagating.

Oliver Chen: that should reduce per-token GPU time. Nice.

Maya Patel: checking dashboard: 429s continue to decline, total token throughput down ~18% which is expected with model swap.

Kai Rivera: preparing handoff notes: will monitor dashboard and logs for 2 more cycles. If 429s spike >2x baseline or 503 rate rebounds, escalate to oncall lead.

Maya Patel: handoff to Kai in 20. Next oncall (Oliver) will be briefed.

Nina Gomez: logging incident in JIRA: INC-7821, adding mitigation steps and customer comms.

Oliver Chen: quick note — please capture which mitigation had most effect (quota bump vs smoothing vs model swap). We'll include in postmortem.

Maya Patel: initial signal: quota bump + smoothing had fastest 429 impact; model swap reduced backend 503s and sustained improvements.

Kai Rivera: thanks. I'll keep watch, will ping if anything changes.

Maya Patel: thanks team. I'll follow-up with detailed timeline and propose follow-up actions: tighter prefix caching, review of batching heuristic introduced yesterday, and a playbook update for tenant-specific quota bumps.

Incident Bot: Incident INC-7821 acknowledged by oncall (Maya Patel).

Kai Rivera: (after 25m) all stable. 429s and 503s near baseline. Removing temporary rate adds and restoring smoothing to default.

Maya Patel: rolling back alpha-market quota to previous level now.

Maya Patel: rollback complete. Monitoring shows no rebound.

Nina Gomez: CS updated customer and closed the interim note.

Maya Patel: wrapping up. Will draft timeline and action items for postmortem. Thanks everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:

Oliver Chen: nice quick run. add suggested follow-ups: instrument tenant-level KV cache metrics and add an automated heuristic to detect cache churn after sudden QPS spikes.

Kai Rivera: also add e2e test for the batching heuristic under synthetic spikes.

Maya Patel: noted. Ending thread and creating postmortem doc.
